text:
You need a Project Manager who can coordinate people, keep timelines on track, and maintain clear project documentation while keeping stakeholders aligned.

I’m Noor Halden, and I bring 6 years of experience working with Python and machine learning tools, along with hands-on work building systems that require careful coordination, structured execution, and reliable delivery. I’m comfortable working across technical teams and turning moving parts into a clear plan that can be tracked, adjusted, and delivered on time.

In my work on Delivery support chatbot for Parcelwise Logistics, I built a WhatsApp and SMS assistant that tracks parcels, reschedules deliveries, and hands off to a human with the full context. That project was built with Python, OpenAI API, LangGraph, FastAPI, Redis, and Twilio. It resolved 43% of conversations without an agent and achieved a CSAT of 4.4 out of 5. That experience strengthened my ability to organize work around clear outcomes, manage scope carefully, and keep operations running smoothly when multiple parties are involved.

What I would bring to your team is disciplined project coordination, strong communication, and a practical approach to managing timelines, scope changes, and stakeholder expectations. I’m comfortable working through project plans, tracking progress, escalating issues when needed, and keeping documentation organized and current. I understand the importance of being a dependable point of contact and making sure internal resources and external partners stay aligned with the project objective.

I also value structured workflow and accountability, which fits well with maintaining comprehensive project documentation and supporting operational cycles. If selected, I would focus on keeping projects organized, risks visible, and delivery moving forward with minimal friction.

I’d be glad to discuss how my background can support your project management needs and help coordinate successful delivery across your team and vendors.
